# Star particles — Style Prompt

> Deep-space black with a thin, slow drift of dust. Each beat is one quiet centred card: the words gather out of scattered points of light glyph by glyph, list rows condense out of haze, and a number is built by a swarm of particles that snaps into a 5×7 dot matrix. One main colour only, kept for a soft halo on the key word. Between beats the frame warps through the dust and goes dark for a breath. Abstract, calm, a feeling of something emerging.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

The film is **a black void with words emerging from it**. Nothing is drawn but type, dots and two hairlines. Every beat is a centred archetype (a chapter card, a heading over a centred list, one giant figure) that forms out of dust, holds still while the dust keeps drifting, and is carried away by a warp. The particles mean something: they are the raw parts that become a title, a row or a number. Emphasis is light, not size: one key word per beat lights from inside in the main colour.

Not a particle explosion or full-screen sparkle (that is what makes particles look cheap), not a starfield fly-through (the only burst is the 0.75 s warp between beats), not a nebula, gradient sky or 3D space scene, not neon or cyberpunk (no glowing outlines, no scanlines), not a text wall: never a paragraph on the particle field. At most 140 motes of dust, most of them faint.

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Void**: flat `--latar` with a vignette, `radial-gradient(130% 90% at 50% 45%)` clear to 55%, then the background darkened toward black at about 45% in the corners. No texture, no grain, no gradient sky.
- **Dust**: 140 round motes, 2-6 px across, 12-62% opacity, in the text colour. Drawn once as two SVG layers of 65-75 motes and moved only by transforms: each layer drifts its own line across the whole film (rising 55-125 px, sideways up to ±26 px) while the whole field is pushed in slowly, so the motes seem to drift on their own. No twinkle, no blur, no lines between dots.
- **Particles** (the dot-matrix figure and the warp): discs with a soft halo, drawn as one radial gradient: a solid core to about 43% of the radius (text colour in the figure, `--aksen` in the warp), then the main colour at 30-55% fading to nothing, the box about 2.2× the core. Never `box-shadow` or `filter` glows on moving dots.
- **Haze** (rows condensing): a copy of the row whose letters are only a 14 px text-shadow, painted once on its own layer, fades out while the sharp row fades in. It reads as a blur clearing without animating `filter`.
- **Halo**: a soft radial gradient in the main colour (30%) behind the key word, its opacity tied to the word's colour change. Not an animated `text-shadow`.
- **Hairlines**: a 1 px rule at 35% text, 260 px wide, centred under the chapter title; 2 px rules at 9% text under each list row, spanning the list column.
- **The tag**: fixed bottom-left through every beat: a mono label (a running number like "07 / 30"), the name, a small muted second name beside it, and two 34 px swatch dots (text colour, main colour). The warp curtain dims it with everything else.
- Nothing else: no cards, panels, icons, photos or frames. `--latar-2` hardly appears.

## 3. Colour logic

| Role | Token | Where |
|---|---|---|
| The void | `--latar` | ground, the warp curtain, the vignette (mixed toward black) |
| Second surface | `--latar-2` | only if a beat needs a quiet panel (a quote card); the example has none |
| The one signal | `--utama` | the halo behind the key word, particle halos, the second swatch dot |
| Signal as type | `--utama-di-latar` | the chapter number, list bullets, the key word once its halo lights |
| Light | `--teks` | every title and row, the dust, particle cores, the first swatch dot |
| Quiet type | `--teks-redup` | mono labels, the tag's second name |
| Passing light | `--aksen` | only the cores of the warp particles |
| Text on fills | `--teks-di-utama`, `--teks-di-aksen` | unused: this look sets no text on colour fields |

Fixed by the look: there is no colour of its own; hairlines are `--teks` at 9-35%, the vignette is `--latar` mixed toward black. The source's violet becomes `--utama`. On a pale brand the dust becomes dark specks on paper and the halo a pale glow; the key word may fall back to `--teks`, and the glow alone still marks it. Never set the dot-matrix figure in `--utama`: its cores are `--teks` so it reads on any ground.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` carries every line that is read: the chapter title 124 px, the list heading 86 px, list rows 62 px, the unit under the figure 76 px, the tag name 54 px. Inter 600, letter-spacing 0.01em, line height 1.12, always centred. The source used a medium-weight CJK sans; a neutral grotesk at 500-600 keeps its calm (Inter 600, Space Grotesk 500, Noto Sans 700 at 0.95× size). Avoid display and condensed faces.
- `--font-isi` carries the note under the figure: Inter 400, 44 px.
- Look tokens: `--font-angka` (Space Grotesk 700) for the chapter number, 170 px, letter-spacing -0.04em, line height 0.9, in `--utama-di-latar`, and for the tag's small second name (32 px, `--teks-redup`); `--font-label` (IBM Plex Mono 600) for labels, uppercase, 26 px with 0.3em tracking in `--teks-redup` (the tag's label 22 px, 0.2em).
- **The dot-matrix figure** is not a font: a 5×7 grid per glyph, pitch 0.105 × the figure's font size (300 px gives 32 px), dot 72% of the pitch (23 px), one empty column between glyphs, "." and ":" two columns wide. Five glyphs fill about 900 px. The typeset figure stays underneath, transparent.
- Keep titles to about 12 characters at 124 px and rows under 20 characters at 62 px: a wider brand font needs the room.

## 5. Motion quality

- **Eases**: enter `power2.out`, exit `power2.in`, no overshoot anywhere.
- **Converge** (titles, labels, units, notes): each glyph starts at a random angle 110-340 px from home at scale 0.3 and opacity 0, and flies home in 0.85 s `power2.out`, its start random within 0.28 s; the next line of the same block starts 0.12 s later. A title is in about 1.1 s after it starts.
- **Converge rows** (lists): a whole row comes from a random direction (up to 160 px across, 90 px up or down) at scale 0.9 and lands in 0.85 s `power2.out`; over the same 0.85 s its haze copy fades out (`power1.out`) and the sharp letters fade in (`power2.in`). Rows start 0.5 s apart, the first about 1.3 s after the heading starts.
- **Halo**: the key word turns `--utama-di-latar` and its glow rises over 0.6 s `power2.out`, about 0.5-0.8 s after its line lands. One per beat.
- **Particle form** (numbers): every dot of the figure starts 380-900 px away at scale 0.25 and lands in 1.15 s `expo.out`, starts random within 0.4 s, so a loose swarm suddenly locks into the grid. The unit converges 1.05 s after the swarm starts, the note 0.4 s after that.
- **Warp** (between beats): 40 particles burst from the frame centre (45% height), from 20-100 px out to 700-1300 px, scale 0.4 to 1.6, fading, 0.75 s `power2.in`, starts spread over 0.15 s. A `--latar` curtain rises over 0.3 s `power2.in` from 0.1 s, covers fully at 0.4 s (swap the scenes there) and clears over 0.4 s `power2.out`. Then 0.45 s of empty, drifting dust before the next beat starts converging: the breath is part of the look.
- **Arriving mid-warp**: the film opens as if it came through a warp half a second ago: on the first frame the burst is already spread and fading and the title's glyphs are a third of the way in, dim and small. The hook is readable by 0.6 s and nothing is ever an empty black first frame.
- **Holds**: a beat spends about 1.2-1.6 s arriving and the rest holding still: in the example the chapter title holds 2.4 s (its label lands 0.9 s before the warp), the list holds 2 s after its last row, the ending 2 s.
- **Ambient**: the camera's slow push on the dust field (1 → 1.04) and the dust drift run linearly for the whole film; the words never move while they are being read.

## 6. Camera grammar

The camera barely moves: depth comes from the dust layers, change comes from particles.

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Slow push, the dust field 1 → 1.04 linear over the film, origin 50% 45%; the words hold still | quiet attention, moving deeper into the space | every beat |
| Dust drift, two layers at different speeds | the space is alive, depth without 3D | all holds |
| Converge (glyphs from 110-340 px) | an idea forming out of noise | titles, names, a quote, the closing line |
| Swarm settle (dots from 380-900 px into a grid) | many small parts becoming one result | numbers, prices, times, dates, scores |
| Warp through the dust (0.75 s burst, curtain 0.3 s up, 0.4 s down) | a jump to the next idea, a chapter break | between beats only, never inside one |

## 7. Native moves

- **The gathered title.** The film arrives through a warp; a main-colour chapter number and the title assemble out of drifting motes glyph by glyph, a hairline grows from the centre, a mono label gathers 1 s later. *Fits content like:* "Bab 02 · Gravitasi" opening a science class; a podcast's episode number and title; a night tour's name; the first line of a short ghost story.
- **Rows out of the haze.** A heading lands, then each row condenses out of blur from its own direction, half a second apart, a faint rule under each. *Fits content like:* three things to bring on a stargazing night; three rules of a meditation studio; a creator's three tools for night shots; three clues in a mystery.
- **The swarm figure.** A loose cloud of light flies in and locks into a giant dot-matrix number; the unit and a note gather beneath it. *Fits content like:* a departure time "19.30"; a pass rate "92%" for a tutoring course; a channel's "1.200" subscribers; the hour a story's lights went out.
- **The halo word.** After the line settles, one word lights from inside in the main colour with a soft glow, and keeps it. *Fits content like:* the "3" in "Cukup 3 langkah"; a chat number on the ending; the name of the winner in a comparison; the last word of a quote.
- **The warp jump.** Dust bursts outward from the centre as the frame dims to the void for a breath, and the next beat starts forming as it clears. *Fits content like:* chapter breaks in a lesson; "minggu depan" in a creator's teaser; from the problem to the answer in a shop's explainer; a time skip in a story.

## 8. Pitfalls

- **Cheap particles**: no explosions, sparkle loops or confetti; at most 140 motes of dust, about 80 dots in a figure and 40-60 in a warp. The dust stays faint (most motes under 40%).
- **Text walls**: one idea per beat, about 7 words in the main line, rows under 20 characters. Long body text dies on a particle field.
- **Two halos**: one key word per beat glows; everything else stays `--teks`.
- **Performance (live preview)**: draw the dust once and move two layers; never one tween per mote. Push the dust field, not the scenes (a scaled full-frame scene layer costs every frame), and paint the vignette into the root's background instead of a layer of its own. No animated `filter` or `text-shadow`: the rows' blur is a haze copy painted once and faded, the halo is a gradient behind the word, particle halos are gradients inside the dot. Hide the scene behind the curtain with `autoAlpha`.
- **Dot-matrix glyphs**: the figure needs a 5×7 mask per character (digits, ".", ":", "%" in the example); add a letter's mask before using it, and keep figures to five or six glyphs at 300 px (or smaller pitch for more).
- **Safe zones**: the tag sits 420 px above the bottom edge (the source had it lower); nothing important in the top 250 px.
- **Pale brands**: the glow nearly disappears on white; the words still read because they are all `--teks`. Check that the halo word stays visible (it falls back to `--teks`, which is fine) and that the dust does not look like dirt (keep opacities low).
- **Keep the void empty**: no nebula gradients, photos or shapes behind the text; the darkness is the material.

## Measured from the reference

- Beats: chapter 0-3.4 s, list 3.4-9.95 s, figure 9.95-15 s; the warps start at 3.0 s and 9.55 s and cover at +0.4 s.
- After each cover: 0.45 s of dust only, then the heading (or the swarm) starts.
- Chapter: title in by about 0.6 s, label starts at 1.0 s. List: heading in 1.1 s, halo 0.9 s after the heading starts, rows at +1.8, +2.3 and +2.8 s. Figure: swarm locked about 0.6 s after it starts, unit at +1.05 s, note at +1.45 s, halo at +1.95 s.
- Sizes at 1080 wide: chapter block top 700 px, list heading top 420 px, list from 820 px with 132 px rows across 780 px, figure top 580-640 px about 860 px wide, the tag at the bottom left with an 80 px margin.

## Variation space

The source places its three archetypes in other positions too: the chapter card left-aligned at x 80, y 640 with a full-width rule; the list with its heading at the top and rows left-aligned; the figure left-aligned at y 600. Keep one alignment per film. The figure can also be a price or a score; the warp can be replaced by a plain curtain dip when beats come faster than 2.5 s.

# Star particles: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2.8, medium 4.2, long 6.

## hook

- en: arrives mid-warp: a main-colour number and the title gather out of dust letter by letter; a hairline and mono label follow
- id: masuk di tengah lompatan: nomor berwarna utama dan judul terkumpul dari debu huruf demi huruf; garis rambut dan label menyusul

## problem

- en: one short line converges in the centre and holds; its key word turns grey, then a warp scatters it outward
- id: satu kalimat pendek terkumpul di tengah lalu diam; kata kuncinya meredup, lalu lompatan partikel menyebarkannya

## fact

- en: a mono label and one line converge from dust; the key word lights from inside with a soft main-colour halo
- id: label mono dan satu kalimat terkumpul dari debu; kata kuncinya menyala dari dalam dengan pendar warna utama

## step

- en: a centred list: each row condenses out of haze from its own direction, 0.5 s apart, a hairline under each
- id: daftar di tengah: tiap baris memadat dari kabut dari arahnya sendiri, berjarak 0,5 detik, garis rambut di bawahnya

## compare

- en: two centred rows condense one after the other; the winner's figure lights with the halo, the other stays dim
- id: dua baris di tengah memadat bergantian; angka pemenang menyala dengan pendar, yang lain tetap redup

## number

- en: a cloud of dust flies in and settles into a giant 5×7 dot-matrix figure; the unit converges below it
- id: awan debu terbang masuk dan mengendap jadi angka titik 5×7 raksasa; satuannya terkumpul di bawahnya

## proof

- en: a quote converges line by line in the centre, the source's name gathers below in mono; nothing else moves
- id: kutipan terkumpul baris demi baris di tengah, nama sumbernya menyusul dalam huruf mono; selebihnya diam

## offer

- en: the price forms out of particles as a dot-matrix figure; the offer line converges below and its key word glows
- id: harga tersusun dari partikel jadi angka titik; kalimat penawaran terkumpul di bawahnya, kata kuncinya berpendar

## cta

- en: a dot-matrix figure (time, date or price) forms, name and contact converge, the contact glows; held 2 s
- id: angka titik (jam, tanggal, atau harga) tersusun, nama dan kontak terkumpul, kontak berpendar; diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: one closing line converges out of the dust, the key word lights with the halo, the field drifts on; held 2 s
- id: satu kalimat penutup terkumpul dari debu, kata kuncinya menyala berpendar, debu terus melayang; diam 2 detik

<!doctype html>
<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1080, height=1920" />
    <title>Partikel bintang</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Inter"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Inter"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 600; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Space Grotesk"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 700; }
      @font-face { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 600; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. */
      :root {
        --latar: #05060a; --latar-2: #0d0f16; --utama: #9b8cff; --aksen: #f2f3f8;
        --teks: #f2f3f8; --teks-redup: #7d8296; --teks-di-utama: #05060a; --teks-di-aksen: #05060a;
        --utama-di-latar: #9b8cff; --aksen-di-latar: #f2f3f8;
        --font-judul: "Inter", "Noto Sans", sans-serif; --font-isi: "Inter", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
        /* Milik tampilan ini: angka bab Latin tebal, label mono, debu, garis rambut, pendar, vinyet. */
        --font-angka: "Space Grotesk", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
        --font-label: "IBM Plex Mono", "Noto Sans", monospace;
        --debu: var(--teks);
        --garis: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 9%, transparent);
        --pendar: color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 55%, transparent);
        --pendar-tipis: color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 30%, transparent);
        --vinyet: color-mix(in oklab, color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 55%, black) 42%, transparent);
      }
      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
      html, body { width: 1080px; height: 1920px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }
      /* Vinyet dilukis di latar akar (bukan lapisan sendiri): satu lapisan layar penuh lebih sedikit tiap frame. */
      #root { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden;
        background: radial-gradient(130% 90% at 50% 45%, transparent 55%, var(--vinyet)), var(--latar);
        color: var(--teks); font-family: var(--font-isi); -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
      .lap { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; }
      /* Debu: dua lapis SVG digambar sekali, hanya digeser (sedikit lebih besar dari layar supaya tepinya tak terlihat);
         kamera mendorong medan debunya, bukan teks. */
      #langit { transform-origin: 50% 45%; will-change: transform; }
      .lapis { position: absolute; left: -40px; top: -20px; width: 1160px; height: 2080px; fill: var(--debu); will-change: transform; }
      .scene { position: absolute; inset: 0; }
      .wd { display: inline-block; white-space: nowrap; }
      .ch { display: inline-block; white-space: pre; }
      .lbl { font-family: var(--font-label); font-weight: 600; font-size: 26px; letter-spacing: 0.3em;
        text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      .jdl { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; line-height: 1.12; }
      /* halo: --g 0 → 1 menyalakan kata kunci dari dalam: warna utama + pendar gradien di belakangnya (bukan text-shadow beranimasi). */
      em { position: relative; display: inline-block; font-style: normal; --g: 0;
        color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama-di-latar) calc(var(--g) * 100%), var(--teks)); }
      em::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -0.45em -0.35em; opacity: var(--g); will-change: opacity;
        background: radial-gradient(closest-side, var(--pendar-tipis), transparent); }
      em .wd { position: relative; } /* huruf dilukis di atas pendar */

      /* Adegan 1: kartu bab di tengah. */
      #kartu { position: absolute; left: 70px; right: 70px; top: 700px; text-align: center; }
      #kartu .num { font-family: var(--font-angka); font-weight: 700; font-size: 170px; line-height: 0.9;
        letter-spacing: -0.04em; color: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      #kartu .ttl { margin-top: 26px; font-size: 124px; }
      #kartu .rule { margin: 30px auto 0; width: 260px; height: 1px; background: var(--teks); opacity: 0.35; }
      #kartu .lbl { margin-top: 30px; }
      /* Adegan 2: label + judul di atas, daftar di tengah dengan garis rambut. */
      #kepala { position: absolute; left: 120px; right: 120px; top: 420px; text-align: center; }
      #kepala .ttl { margin-top: 20px; font-size: 86px; }
      #daftar { position: absolute; left: 150px; right: 150px; top: 820px; list-style: none; }
      #daftar li { position: relative; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: baseline; gap: 22px; padding: 33px 0; }
      #daftar .idx { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 600; font-size: 62px; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      #daftar .txt { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 600; font-size: 62px; line-height: 1.1; }
      #daftar .rule { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 2px; background: var(--garis); }
      /* Bayangan kabur baris (dilukis sekali), memudar sementara teks tajam muncul: blur tanpa filter beranimasi. */
      #daftar .kabur { position: absolute; inset: 0; color: transparent; text-shadow: 0 0 14px var(--teks); will-change: opacity; }
      #daftar .kabur .idx { color: transparent; text-shadow: 0 0 14px var(--utama); }
      #daftar .kabur .rule { display: none; }
      #daftar .tajam { will-change: opacity; }
      /* Adegan 3: angka titik 5×7 raksasa, satuan, catatan. */
      #angka { position: absolute; left: 100px; right: 100px; top: 580px; text-align: center; }
      #angka .val { position: relative; font-family: var(--font-angka); font-weight: 700; font-size: 300px; line-height: 0.9; white-space: nowrap; }
      .titik { position: absolute; top: 15px; height: 1em; }
      .titik i { position: absolute; border-radius: 50%;
        background: radial-gradient(closest-side, var(--teks) 43%, var(--pendar-tipis) 48%, transparent 85%); }
      #angka .unit { margin-top: 60px; font-size: 76px; }
      #angka .note { margin-top: 56px; font-size: 44px; line-height: 1.3; font-weight: 400; }
      /* Penanda tetap kiri bawah: label mono, nama, dua titik warna. */
      #tanda { position: absolute; left: 80px; bottom: 420px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
      #tanda .k { font-family: var(--font-label); font-weight: 600; font-size: 22px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      #tanda .n { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 600; font-size: 54px; line-height: 1.1; }
      #tanda .n small { margin-left: 16px; font-family: var(--font-angka); font-weight: 700; font-size: 32px; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      #tanda .sw { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-top: 6px; }
      #tanda .sw i { display: block; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--teks); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--garis); }
      #tanda .sw i + i { background: var(--utama); }
      /* Pindah adegan: tirai warna latar + titik lompatan dari tengah. */
      #tirai { background: var(--latar); }
      .awan { position: absolute; inset: 0; }
      .awan i { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 45%; width: 22px; height: 22px; margin: -11px; border-radius: 50%;
        background: radial-gradient(closest-side, var(--aksen) 38%, var(--pendar) 48%, transparent); }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1080" data-height="1920" data-fps="30">
      <div class="lap" id="langit"></div>

      <section class="scene" id="s1" data-role="hook"><!-- Adegan 1, pembuka: masuk di tengah lompatan; nomor dan judul terkumpul dari debu huruf demi huruf, garis rambut, label. -->
        <div id="kartu">
          <div class="num">01</div>
          <div class="ttl jdl">Laut menyala</div>
          <div class="rule"></div>
          <div class="lbl">Tur malam · Teluk Sinar</div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="scene" id="s2" data-role="step"><!-- Adegan 2, langkah: angka kunci berpendar, tiap baris memadat dari kabut. -->
        <div id="kepala">
          <div class="lbl">Sebelum berangkat</div>
          <div class="ttl jdl">Cukup <em id="tiga">3</em> langkah</div>
        </div>
        <ul id="daftar">
          <li><span class="idx">·</span><span class="txt">Datang saat gelap</span><i class="rule"></i></li>
          <li><span class="idx">·</span><span class="txt">Lampu kapal padam</span><i class="rule"></i></li>
          <li><span class="idx">·</span><span class="txt">Celup tangan ke air</span><i class="rule"></i></li>
        </ul>
      </section>

      <section class="scene" id="s3" data-role="cta"><!-- Adegan 3, ajakan: jam berangkat tersusun dari partikel, satuan dan kontak menyusul, nomor Chat berpendar. -->
        <div id="angka">
          <div class="val" id="jam">19.30</div>
          <div class="unit jdl">Berangkat tiap malam</div>
          <div class="note">Pesan kursi · Chat <em id="wa">0812-3456-7890</em></div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <div id="tanda">
        <div class="k">Malam 07 / 30</div>
        <div class="n">Teluk Sinar<small>Tur plankton</small></div>
        <div class="sw"><i></i><i></i></div>
      </div>
      <div class="lap" id="tirai"></div>
      <div class="lap" id="lompat"></div>
    </div>
    <script>
      (() => {
        const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
        const $ = (s) => document.querySelector(s);
        const $$ = (s) => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(s));
        // PRNG berbiji (mulberry32): debu dan arah huruf sama di pratinjau dan render.
        let seed = 12;
        const R = () => {
          seed = (seed + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
          let t = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed);
          t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
          return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
        };
        const MASUK = 0.85, BARIS = 0.12, TAU = Math.PI * 2, SVG = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
        const make = (tag, cls, par) => par.appendChild(Object.assign(document.createElement(tag), { className: cls }));

        // Debu: 140 titik (r 1-3 px, 12-62% terlihat) di dua lapis; tiap lapis hanyut di garisnya sendiri sepanjang film.
        for (const [dx, dy, n] of [[22, -55, 75], [-26, -125, 65]]) {
          const s = $("#langit").appendChild(document.createElementNS(SVG, "svg"));
          s.setAttribute("class", "lapis");
          s.setAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 1160 2080");
          for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            const c = s.appendChild(document.createElementNS(SVG, "circle"));
            const a = { cx: R() * 1160, cy: R() * 2080, r: 1 + R() * 2, "fill-opacity": 0.12 + R() * 0.5 };
            for (const k in a) c.setAttribute(k, a[k].toFixed(2));
          }
          tl.fromTo(s, { x: 0, y: 0 }, { x: dx, y: dy, duration: 15, ease: "none" }, 0);
        }

        // Pecah teks jadi huruf (.ch); huruf satu kata dalam kotak .wd supaya baris tidak patah di tengah kata.
        function huruf(el) {
          const out = [];
          const walk = (node) => [...node.childNodes].forEach((c) => {
            if (c.nodeType === 1) return walk(c);
            if (c.nodeType !== 3) return;
            const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
            for (const tok of c.textContent.split(/(\s+)/)) {
              if (!tok) continue;
              if (/^\s+$/.test(tok)) { frag.append(" "); continue; }
              const w = make("span", "wd", frag);
              for (const ch of tok) out.push(Object.assign(make("span", "ch", w), { textContent: ch }));
            }
            c.replaceWith(frag);
          });
          walk(el);
          return out;
        }
        // fromTo yang sudah berjalan m detik saat film dimulai: berangkat dari keadaan di titik itu (pembuka masuk di tengah gerak).
        function gerak(el, from, to, dur, ease, t, m = 0) {
          if (m > 0) {
            const e = gsap.parseEase(ease)(Math.min(1, m / dur));
            for (const k in from) from[k] += (to[k] - from[k]) * e;
            dur -= m;
            if (ease.endsWith(".in")) ease = "power1.in"; // sisa power2.out tetap power2.out
          }
          tl.fromTo(el, from, { ...to, duration: dur, ease }, t);
        }
        // converge: tiap huruf terkumpul dari debu (sudut acak, 110-340 px, skala 0,3 → 1), 0,85 dtk power2.out,
        // mulai acak dalam 0,28 dtk; baris berikutnya 0,12 dtk kemudian. m: detik yang sudah lewat di awal film.
        const kumpul = (sels, t, m = 0) => [sels].flat().forEach((sel, i) => huruf($(sel)).forEach((c) => {
          const a = R() * TAU, r = 110 + R() * 230, d = i * BARIS + R() * 0.28 - m;
          gerak(c, { autoAlpha: 0, x: Math.cos(a) * r, y: Math.sin(a) * r, scale: 0.3 }, { autoAlpha: 1, x: 0, y: 0, scale: 1 },
            MASUK, "power2.out", t + Math.max(0, d), Math.max(0, -d));
        }));
        // converge-rows: satu baris memadat dari arah acak (160 × 90 px), skala 0,9 → 1, dari kabur 14 px → tajam
        // (salinan kabur memudar, teks tajam muncul).
        function memadat(li, t) {

          tl.fromTo(li, { autoAlpha: 0, x: Math.cos(a) * 160, y: Math.sin(a) * 90, scale: 0.9 },
            { autoAlpha: 1, x: 0, y: 0, scale: 1, duration: MASUK, ease: "power2.out" }, t);
          tl.fromTo(tajam, { opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1, duration: MASUK, ease: "power2.in" }, t);
          tl.fromTo(kabur, { autoAlpha: 1 }, { autoAlpha: 0, duration: MASUK, ease: "power1.out" }, t);

          0: "01110100011001110101110011000101110", 1: "00100011000010000100001000010001110", 2: "01110100010000100010001000100011111",

          9: "01110100011000101111000010001001100", ".": "00000000001111", ":": "00111100111100", "%": "11000110010001000100010001001100011",
        };

          const fs = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(el).fontSize), p = Math.round(fs * 0.105), d = Math.round(p * 0.72), b = Math.round(d * 2.2);

              dots.push(dot);
            });
            x0 += p * (w + 1);
          }
          host.style.left = `calc(50% - ${(lo + hi) / 2}px)`; // pusat titik yang menyala, bukan kotak glyph
          el.style.color = "transparent"; // angka ketik tetap ada di bawahnya
          for (const dot of dots) {
            const a = R() * TAU, r = 380 + R() * 520;
            tl.fromTo(dot, { autoAlpha: 0, x: Math.cos(a) * r, y: Math.sin(a) * r, scale: 0.25 },

          }

        // tirai latar menutup 0,3 dtk lalu membuka 0,4 dtk. Kembali: saat layar tertutup penuh.
        // m > 0: film dimulai di tengah lompatan: titik sudah menyebar, tanpa tirai.
        function lompat(t, m = 0) {
          const awan = make("div", "awan", $("#lompat"));
          for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
            const a = R() * TAU, r0 = 20 + R() * 80, r1 = 700 + R() * 600, d = R() * 0.15 - m;
            gerak(make("i", "", awan), { x: Math.cos(a) * r0, y: Math.sin(a) * r0, scale: 0.4, autoAlpha: 0.9 },
              { x: Math.cos(a) * r1, y: Math.sin(a) * r1, scale: 1.6, autoAlpha: 0 }, 0.75, "power2.in", t + Math.max(0, d), Math.max(0, -d));
          }
          tl.set(awan, { autoAlpha: 0 }, t + 0.95 - m);
          if (!m) {
            tl.fromTo(awan, { autoAlpha: 0 }, { autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.01 }, t);
            tl.fromTo("#tirai", { autoAlpha: 0 }, { autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.3, ease: "power2.in", immediateRender: false }, t + 0.1);
            tl.to("#tirai", { autoAlpha: 0, duration: 0.4, ease: "power2.out" }, t + 0.42);
          }
          return t + 0.4 - m;
        }
        const ganti = (keluar, masuk, t) => {
          tl.set(keluar, { autoAlpha: 0 }, t);
          tl.fromTo(masuk, { autoAlpha: 0 }, { autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.01, immediateRender: true }, t);
        };

        // Kamera: slow-push pada medan debu 1 → 1,04 linear sepanjang film; teks yang dibaca tetap diam.
        tl.fromTo("#langit", { scale: 1 }, { scale: 1.04, duration: 15, ease: "none" }, 0);
        tl.set("#tirai", { autoAlpha: 0, immediateRender: true }, 0);

        // ===== 1. Pembuka (0-3,38): masuk di tengah lompatan; nomor + judul sedang terkumpul, garis rambut, label menyusul =====
        lompat(0, 0.5);

        kumpul("#kartu .lbl", 1.0);
        const c1 = lompat(2.98);
        ganti("#s1", "#s2", c1);

        // ===== 2. Langkah (3,38-9,95): 0,45 dtk hening, label + judul terkumpul, angka 3 berpendar, tiga baris memadat 0,5 dtk berjarak =====
        kumpul(["#kepala .lbl", "#kepala .ttl"], c1 + 0.45);

        $$("#daftar li").forEach((li, i) => memadat(li, 5.65 + i * 0.5));
        const c2 = lompat(9.55);
        ganti("#s2", "#s3", c2);

        // ===== 3. Ajakan (9,95-15): 0,45 dtk hening, jam tersusun dari partikel, satuan, kontak, Chat berpendar; diam 2 dtk lebih =====
        bentuk($("#jam"), c2 + 0.45);
        kumpul("#angka .unit", 11.45);
        kumpul("#angka .note", 11.85);
        halo("#wa", 12.35);

        window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
        window.__timelines["main"] = tl;
      })();
    </script>

          tl.fromTo(s, { x: 0, y: 0 }, { x: dx, y: dy, duration: 15, ease: "none" }, 0);
        }

        // Pecah teks jadi huruf (.ch); huruf satu kata dalam kotak .wd supaya baris tidak patah di tengah kata.
        function huruf(el) {
          const out = [];
          const walk = (node) => [...node.childNodes].forEach((c) => {
            if (c.nodeType === 1) return walk(c);
            if (c.nodeType !== 3) return;
            const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
            for (const tok of c.textContent.split(/(\s+)/)) {
              if (!tok) continue;
              if (/^\s+$/.test(tok)) { frag.append(" "); continue; }
              const w = make("span", "wd", frag);
              for (const ch of tok) out.push(Object.assign(make("span", "ch", w), { textContent: ch }));
            }
            c.replaceWith(frag);
          });
          walk(el);
          return out;
        }
        // fromTo yang sudah berjalan m detik saat film dimulai: berangkat dari keadaan di titik itu (pembuka masuk di tengah gerak).
        function gerak(el, from, to, dur, ease, t, m = 0) {
          if (m > 0) {
            const e = gsap.parseEase(ease)(Math.min(1, m / dur));
            for (const k in from) from[k] += (to[k] - from[k]) * e;
            dur -= m;
            if (ease.endsWith(".in")) ease = "power1.in"; // sisa power2.out tetap power2.out
          }
          tl.fromTo(el, from, { ...to, duration: dur, ease }, t);
        }
        // converge: tiap huruf terkumpul dari debu (sudut acak, 110-340 px, skala 0,3 → 1), 0,85 dtk power2.out,
        // mulai acak dalam 0,28 dtk; baris berikutnya 0,12 dtk kemudian. m: detik yang sudah lewat di awal film.
        const kumpul = (sels, t, m = 0) => [sels].flat().forEach((sel, i) => huruf($(sel)).forEach((c) => {
          const a = R() * TAU, r = 110 + R() * 230, d = i * BARIS + R() * 0.28 - m;
          gerak(c, { autoAlpha: 0, x: Math.cos(a) * r, y: Math.sin(a) * r, scale: 0.3 }, { autoAlpha: 1, x: 0, y: 0, scale: 1 },
            MASUK, "power2.out", t + Math.max(0, d), Math.max(0, -d));
        }));
        // converge-rows: satu baris memadat dari arah acak (160 × 90 px), skala 0,9 → 1, dari kabur 14 px → tajam
        // (salinan kabur memudar, teks tajam muncul).
        function memadat(li, t) {
          const a = R() * TAU, tajam = [...li.children];
          const kabur = li.appendChild(Object.assign(li.cloneNode(true), { className: "kabur" }));
          tajam.forEach((c) => c.classList.add("tajam"));
          tl.fromTo(li, { autoAlpha: 0, x: Math.cos(a) * 160, y: Math.sin(a) * 90, scale: 0.9 },
            { autoAlpha: 1, x: 0, y: 0, scale: 1, duration: MASUK, ease: "power2.out" }, t);
          tl.fromTo(tajam, { opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1, duration: MASUK, ease: "power2.in" }, t);
          tl.fromTo(kabur, { autoAlpha: 1 }, { autoAlpha: 0, duration: MASUK, ease: "power1.out" }, t);
        }
        // halo: kata kunci menyala dari dalam, 0,6 dtk.
        const halo = (sel, t) => tl.to(sel, { "--g": 1, duration: 0.6, ease: "power2.out" }, t);

        // particle-form: awan titik terbang masuk dari 380-900 px dan mengendap jadi angka titik 5×7
        // (jarak titik 0,105 × ukuran huruf, titik 72% jarak), expo.out 1,15 dtk, mulai acak dalam 0,4 dtk.
        const DM = {
          0: "01110100011001110101110011000101110", 1: "00100011000010000100001000010001110", 2: "01110100010000100010001000100011111",
          3: "11111000100010000010000011000101110", 4: "00010001100101010010111110001000010", 5: "11111100001111000001000011000101110",
          6: "00110010001000011110100011000101110", 7: "11111000010001000100010000100001000", 8: "01110100011000101110100011000101110",
          9: "01110100011000101111000010001001100", ".": "00000000001111", ":": "00111100111100", "%": "11000110010001000100010001001100011",
        };
        function bentuk(el, t) {
          const fs = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(el).fontSize), p = Math.round(fs * 0.105), d = Math.round(p * 0.72), b = Math.round(d * 2.2);
          const host = make("div", "titik", el), dots = [];
          let x0 = 0, lo = 1e9, hi = 0;
          for (const ch of el.firstChild.textContent.trim()) {
            const g = DM[ch], w = g ? g.length / 7 : 2;
            if (g) [...g].forEach((on, k) => {
              if (on !== "1") return;
              const x = x0 + (k % w) * p, dot = make("i", "", host);
              lo = Math.min(lo, x); hi = Math.max(hi, x + d);
              dot.style.cssText = `left:${x + (d - b) / 2}px;top:${Math.floor(k / w) * p + (d - b) / 2}px;width:${b}px;height:${b}px`;
              dots.push(dot);
            });
            x0 += p * (w + 1);
          }
          host.style.left = `calc(50% - ${(lo + hi) / 2}px)`; // pusat titik yang menyala, bukan kotak glyph
          el.style.color = "transparent"; // angka ketik tetap ada di bawahnya
          for (const dot of dots) {
            const a = R() * TAU, r = 380 + R() * 520;
            tl.fromTo(dot, { autoAlpha: 0, x: Math.cos(a) * r, y: Math.sin(a) * r, scale: 0.25 },
              { autoAlpha: 1, x: 0, y: 0, scale: 1, duration: 1.15, ease: "expo.out" }, t + R() * 0.4);
          }
        }

        // particle-warp: 40 titik melesat keluar dari tengah (r 20-100 → 700-1300 px, skala 0,4 → 1,6, 0,75 dtk power2.in);
        // tirai latar menutup 0,3 dtk lalu membuka 0,4 dtk. Kembali: saat layar tertutup penuh.
        // m > 0: film dimulai di tengah lompatan: titik sudah menyebar, tanpa tirai.
        function lompat(t, m = 0) {
          const awan = make("div", "awan", $("#lompat"));
          for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
            const a = R() * TAU, r0 = 20 + R() * 80, r1 = 700 + R() * 600, d = R() * 0.15 - m;
            gerak(make("i", "", awan), { x: Math.cos(a) * r0, y: Math.sin(a) * r0, scale: 0.4, autoAlpha: 0.9 },
              { x: Math.cos(a) * r1, y: Math.sin(a) * r1, scale: 1.6, autoAlpha: 0 }, 0.75, "power2.in", t + Math.max(0, d), Math.max(0, -d));
          }
          tl.set(awan, { autoAlpha: 0 }, t + 0.95 - m);
          if (!m) {
            tl.fromTo(awan, { autoAlpha: 0 }, { autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.01 }, t);
            tl.fromTo("#tirai", { autoAlpha: 0 }, { autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.3, ease: "power2.in", immediateRender: false }, t + 0.1);
            tl.to("#tirai", { autoAlpha: 0, duration: 0.4, ease: "power2.out" }, t + 0.42);
          }
          return t + 0.4 - m;
        }
        const ganti = (keluar, masuk, t) => {
          tl.set(keluar, { autoAlpha: 0 }, t);
          tl.fromTo(masuk, { autoAlpha: 0 }, { autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.01, immediateRender: true }, t);
        };

        // Kamera: slow-push pada medan debu 1 → 1,04 linear sepanjang film; teks yang dibaca tetap diam.
        tl.fromTo("#langit", { scale: 1 }, { scale: 1.04, duration: 15, ease: "none" }, 0);
        tl.set("#tirai", { autoAlpha: 0, immediateRender: true }, 0);

        // ===== 1. Pembuka (0-3,38): masuk di tengah lompatan; nomor + judul sedang terkumpul, garis rambut, label menyusul =====
        lompat(0, 0.5);
        kumpul(["#kartu .num", "#kartu .ttl"], 0, 0.35);
        tl.fromTo("#kartu .rule", { scaleX: 0 }, { scaleX: 1, duration: 0.5, ease: "power2.out" }, 0.5);
        kumpul("#kartu .lbl", 1.0);
        const c1 = lompat(2.98);
        ganti("#s1", "#s2", c1);

        // ===== 2. Langkah (3,38-9,95): 0,45 dtk hening, label + judul terkumpul, angka 3 berpendar, tiga baris memadat 0,5 dtk berjarak =====
        kumpul(["#kepala .lbl", "#kepala .ttl"], c1 + 0.45);
        halo("#tiga", 4.75);
        $$("#daftar li").forEach((li, i) => memadat(li, 5.65 + i * 0.5));
        const c2 = lompat(9.55);
        ganti("#s2", "#s3", c2);

        // ===== 3. Ajakan (9,95-15): 0,45 dtk hening, jam tersusun dari partikel, satuan, kontak, Chat berpendar; diam 2 dtk lebih =====
        bentuk($("#jam"), c2 + 0.45);
        kumpul("#angka .unit", 11.45);
        kumpul("#angka .note", 11.85);
        halo("#wa", 12.35);

        window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
        window.__timelines["main"] = tl;
      })();
    </script>
  </body>
